## Line 484

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polyhedra.library.plato, line 484](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polyhedra.library.plato#L484).

```plato

    // Snub (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snub_(geometry)): expand with a twist,
    // each edge-quad split into two triangles. Chiral — `twist` > 0 gives one
    // enantiomer, < 0 its mirror. Cube -> snub cube.
    // V' = C, E' = 3E + C, F' = F + V + 2E.
    Snub(self: PolygonMesh3D, shrink: Number, twist: Angle): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMeshOfFaces(
            self.TwistedFacePoints(shrink, twist),
            self.ExpansionFaces((m, c) => m.SnubFacesOfEdge(c)));
```
